ddfrauenkirche.name: Frauenkirche
ddfrauenkirche.slogan: A stone bell, rebuilt from its own rubble.
ddfrauenkirche.line: The church is to Dresden what St. Paul's is to London.
ddfrauenkirche.by: Paul Oestreicher, founder of the Dresden Trust

ddzwinger.name: Zwinger
ddzwinger.slogan: Augustus the Strong's party courtyard, all pavilions and fountains.
ddzwinger.line: Built between 1710 and 1728 by Matthäus Daniel Pöppelmann, with sculpture by Balthasar Permoser.

ddbastei.name: Bastei
ddbastei.slogan: Sandstone needles over the Elbe, and a bridge to walk between them.
ddbastei.line: The seven-arch sandstone bridge was finished in 1851, about 194 metres above the river.

ddmoritzburg.name: Moritzburg Castle
ddmoritzburg.slogan: A hunting lodge afloat on its own lake.
ddmoritzburg.line: Its dining room holds the heaviest red deer antler in the world, at 19.8 kg.

ddalbrechtsburg.name: Albrechtsburg
ddalbrechtsburg.slogan: Where Europe first learned to make porcelain.
ddalbrechtsburg.line: Built from 1471, it became home to the Meissen porcelain manufactory on 6 June 1710.
